world-atlas 2.0.2, https://github.com/topojson/world-atlas (tag v2.0.2)
From the npm package, countries-110m.json, sha256 2516c915867c7baf18ddec727aec46c315541a07cfb3d79a6559b05d5e94eee8
Shipped as vendor/fha-world.js, sha256 94f23c905e51a19753ec6b8f6e2349ec25092d9c0de70a5100ebed98440d6b34
fha-world.js is that JSON file, unchanged apart from its final newline, set as
window.FHA_WORLD after a comment saying where it came from, so a page opened
from disk can load it with a <script> tag.

The map data is Natural Earth 4.1.0 (Admin 0 countries, 1:110m),
https://www.naturalearthdata.com. Natural Earth states: "All versions of
Natural Earth raster + vector map data found on this website are in the
public domain." (https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/)
